forbidden_regressions: <specific historical failure that must not return>
template.truth_boundary: Candidate is not Current/Served until promoted by the proper authority.

mandatory_questions: Can this be solved by removing/fusing/hiding something instead of adding a worker-visible step?
Does the worker truly need to know this, or can Prometeo enforce it below the interface?
What known-good behavior could this silently break?
What simple baseline will falsify the claim that this is an improvement?
Would a fresh unprimed agent still work?
If this fails, can we rollback without archaeology?
Are we measuring product progress or merely control-plane activity?
